name: browser-mcp-automaton
description: A local-first MCP bridge for controlling a user's real Chrome/Edge browser through a browser extension.
author: wenqi

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run build --prefix packages/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/mcp-server && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/extension
